postconditions.description: Both permutations must be of the same length as the input array q.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in lexicographically_minimal) and all(1 <= x <= n for x in lexicographically_maximal)
postconditions.description: Each number in the permutations must be within the range from 1 to n.
Each number must appear exactly once in both permutations.

postconditions.expression: all(lexicographically_minimal[i] <= lexicographically_minimal[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The lexicographically minimal permutation must be non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: all(lexicographically_maximal[i] >= lexicographically_maximal[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The lexicographically maximal permutation must be non-increasing.

postconditions.expression: all(q[i] == max(lexicographically_minimal[:i+1]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The lexicographically minimal permutation must satisfy the condition q_i = max(p_1, p_2, ..., p_i).

postconditions.expression: all(q[i] == max(lexicographically_maximal[:i+1]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The lexicographically maximal permutation must satisfy the condition q_i = max(p_1, p_2, ..., p_i).
